typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> Pair;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int MOD2 = 998244353;

ll comb(int n, int c) {
    if (c > n) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (c == n) {
        return 1;
    }
    ll ans = 1LL;
    for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
        ans *= (n - i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
        ans /= i;
    }
    return ans;
}

double cal(int m, int n) {
    long long ttl = comb(n, 3);
    double ans = 0.0;
    ans += 1.0 * (comb(m, 3));
    ans += 1.0 * (comb(m, 2) * comb(n - m, 1));
    ans += 0.5 * (comb(m, 1) * comb(n - m, 2));
    return ans / ttl;
}

class FastReader {
public:
    string line;
    int pos;
    
    FastReader() : pos(0) {}
    
    string next() {
        while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] == ' ') pos++;
        string res = "";
        while (pos < line.size() && line[pos] != ' ') {
            res += line[pos];
            pos++;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        if (!getline(cin, line)) {
            return "";
        }
        pos = 0;
        return line;
    }
};

class Node {
public:
    int data, open, close;
    
    Node() : data(0), open(0), close(0) {}
    
    Node(int data, int open, int close) : data(data), open(open), close(close) {}
};

class ST {
public:
    int n;
    vector<Node> st;
    
    ST(int n) : n(n) {
        st.resize(4 * (1 << (int)log2(n) + 2));
    }
    
    void build(vector<Node>& nodes) {
        build(0, 0, n - 1, nodes);
    }
    
    void build(int id, int l, int r, vector<Node>& nodes) {
        if (l == r) {
            st[id] = nodes[l];
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        build((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, nodes);
        build((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, nodes);
        st[id] = comb(st[(id << 1) + 1], st[(id << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    void update(int i, Node node) {
        update(0, 0, n - 1, i, node);
    }
    
    void update(int id, int l, int r, int i, Node node) {
        if (i < l || r < i) {
            return;
        }
        if (l == r) {
            st[id] = node;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        update((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, i, node);
        update((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, i, node);
        st[id] = comb(st[(id << 1) + 1], st[(id << 1) + 2]);
    }
    
    Node get(int x, int y) {
        return get(0, 0, n - 1, x, y);
    }
    
    Node get(int id, int l, int r, int x, int y) {
        if (x > r || y < l) {
            return Node();
        }
        if (x <= l && r <= y) {
            return st[id];
        }
        int mid = (l + r) >> 1;
        return comb(get((id << 1) + 1, l, mid, x, y), get((id << 1) + 2, mid + 1, r, x, y));
    }
    
    Node comb(Node a, Node b) {
        if (a.data == 0 && a.open == 0 && a.close == 0) {
            return b;
        }
        if (b.data == 0 && b.open == 0 && b.close == 0) {
            return a;
        }
        int min_val = min(a.open, b.close);
        return Node(a.data + b.data + min_val * 2, a.open + b.open - min_val, a.close + b.close - min_val);
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n;
    double p;
    cin >> n >> p;
    
    int l = 0;
    int r = n - 1;
    while (l < r) {
        int m = (l + r) / 2;
        double x = cal(m, n);
        if (x >= p) {
            r = m;
        } else {
            l = m + 1;
        }
    }
    cout << l << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int tt = 1;
    while (tt-- > 0) {
        solve();
    }
    
    return 0;
}
